name: AMD Instinct MI350X product page (TBP and Passive OAM cooling)
notes: Live AMD product page. Requirements section: 'Typical Board Power (TBP) 1000W (TBP)' and 'External Power Connectors 54V UBB'. Board Specifications section: 'Cooling: Passive OAM'. Passive OAM is the decisive fact: an OAM module has no onboard heat sink or fan, so it REQUIRES a liquid cold plate in the host chassis and cannot be air-cooled in a conventional server.
